name: What is the process for a hallway clearance renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a hallway clearance renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally begins with an initial consultation and site visit to assess your current hallway and discuss your goals. We then provide a detailed proposal and design plan. Upon approval, we handle necessary permits. Construction involves demolition, framing changes, electrical/plumbing adjustments if needed, drywall installation, and finishing touches. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication and manage all aspects to ensure a smooth renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The renovation process includes consultation, design, permitting, demolition, construction (framing, utilities, drywall), and finishing touches.
